answer: Price each added identity as a non-parallelizable bond plus upkeep. To vote or earn, an agent must lock stake in a bonded orchard that only matures after successive challenge windows; early exit slashes the bond. A zephyr of one-shot accounts cannot wait out those windows without tying up capital the whole time. So a nebula of clones scales the attacker's locked funds and opportunity cost linearly, while an honest agent tends one history and reuses its matured bond.
